independent_findings.name: private-symbol-linker-assertion
independent_findings.detail: The linker script addressed private C names c2_phase_owner and c2_committed_roots directly; lld does not expose those local names to script expressions even though their dedicated input sections are present.

session_emitter_residency.pre_ownership_reachability: none by product sequencing; both are session-emitter-only

recommended_next_layout.private_state_markers: Define linker-owned boundary symbols immediately before each exact KEEP input section; keep the C objects private.
recommended_next_layout.handoff: Place the historical handoff explicitly at 0xb481.
recommended_next_layout.session_emitter_residency: Move the 40-byte c2_facade_target_c2e_cons implementation and its 346-byte c2e state into named owned-E000 code/state sections; its fixed facade vector remains at 0xb5ab. Both objects are session-only and the pre-ownership closure must reject any edge to them.
recommended_next_layout.required_gate: The session-only target and state must be absent from the pre-ownership call/data closure, and all fixed state positions must be checked through linker-owned markers.
recommended_next_layout.authorization: A fresh link attempt requires review; the real link remains authoritative for every projected value.

claim_limit: First-red layout evidence only. Projected relocation values are not capacity authorization, product identity, structural closure, hardware acceptance or promotion claims.
